verdict.rationale: Meltano's docs show loaders move data (often as JSON-based Singer records) and require a separate dbt transformation step to type and model data (meltano-docs-6, meltano-docs-11), plus incremental state tracking (meltano-docs-20) that dedupes on replication key changes but doesn't guarantee typed, deduplicated final tables without additional dbt modeling. There is no direct evidence that the loader itself produces analyst-ready typed/deduplicated tables without extra transformation work. missing for 10: evidence that loaders alone type and dedupe destination tables, independent confirmation of load-time schema casting, and hands-on validation that raw JSON is not exposed to end users.
